comparison.objective: Build a stable 3-2-1 pyramid from six cans; candidate tunes and locks a shock absorber for repeatable safe stopping.
comparison.physical_skill: Can task tests repeated grasp-transfer, upright placement, precise bridging, and disturbance avoidance. Candidate tests recessed tool use, captive setscrew manipulation, fine rotary adjustment, counterholding, relocking, and iterative dynamic diagnosis.
comparison.success_condition: Can success requires three supported tiers with stated spacing, bridging, uprightness, rest, and no tipped or single-can tower arrangement. Candidate requires two energy-qualified impact stops without bottoming, overload, excessive rebound, or setting drift. Candidate rebound/drift tolerances are not numerically defined.
comparison.reason: Stable multi-object construction does not test adjustable mechanism operation, lock retention, or dynamic energy-absorption commissioning.
